author: mara
story: A German field technician finds the open ticket for a faulted charge point, has the fast model tidy his bullet points into a ticket note, and adds it to the ticket. The write goes through ctx.confirm with the full note in the summary, and Jonas confirms it. The ticket belongs to a German charge point, which Jonas may see.

input.bullets:
- RCD tripped twice after rain
- replaced RCD type B module
- 3 test sessions ok, 148 kW peak

input.text: RCD tripped twice after rain. Replaced the RCD type B module. Three test sessions completed, 148 kW peak.
